registration_scope: Local prospective allocation endpoint and decision specification, recorded before any empirical A0 data; not external preregistration or a full protocol freeze
replication_unit: Independently acquired/model seed, not ticks or evaluator forks

assay.exposure: Balanced per-coordinate marginal R/T fault rates; true faults withheld
assay.performing_bank: R includes every learned operator computing repair, including dual-use and self-update operators
assay.comparison_bank: T includes real task-only learned coefficients; no dummy padding

primary_endpoint.writes: Unique learned destinations actually changed by accepted system writes per tick; exclude damage, zero changes, duplicates and V
primary_endpoint.opportunities: All eligible scalar destinations over all 1024 planned ticks, including collapsed periods
primary_endpoint.both_densities_zero: A=0 with explicit NO_ALLOCATION flag; retained as failure
primary_endpoint.interpretation: Meaningful damage-induced write-allocation enrichment; not useful repair by itself

phase_a_license.scope: Proceed to Phase A protocol for the same boundary/minimum surviving mechanism; no automatic training or final execution
phase_a_license.ordinary_control_reproduction: License only reduced instrumental-control maintenance interpretation if functional conditions pass
phase_a_license.null_allocation_or_absent_causal_self_ma: End specified learned-self-priority route; no Phase A under that hypothesis

remaining_before_any_execution: Human review and explicit empirical A0 authorization
Exact graph, precision, fault doses and dependency audit
Task-only objective, training schedule and whole-arm resource budget
Implementation/source/config/seed freeze reviewed before untouched runs
change_rule: No post-result edits; prospective changes require an additive versioned successor before execution
